description: This file defines structures and logic for evaluating execution approval, including security checks, allowlist matching, and skill auto-allowance logic within an application, likely related to command execution authorization.

classes.name: ExecApprovalEvaluation
classes.description: A data structure representing the result of an execution approval evaluation, including command details, security info, allowlist matches, and skill allowance status.

classes.name: ExecApprovalEvaluator
classes.description: A static utility class providing methods to evaluate command approval, including security checks, allowlist matching, and auto-allow logic.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Asynchronously evaluates whether a command is approved based on security policies, allowlist, and skill trust, returning an ExecApprovalEvaluation object.

methods.name: isSkillAutoAllowed
methods.description: Determines if the command resolution is auto-allowed based on trusted skill bins.

methods.name: _testIsSkillAutoAllowed
methods.description: Test method for isSkillAutoAllowed, used for unit testing.
